paragraphs: A Land Rover M47D20 engine rebuild starts from £1,900, regardless of which of the two applications it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the specific vehicle. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Land Rover already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most M47D20 (BMW-Sourced) owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six M47D20 (BMW-Sourced)-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Land Rover M47D20 engine?
faqLeft.a: The M47D20 is a BMW-sourced 2.0-litre turbocharged diesel engine, used in Land Rover Defender and Freelander applications between 2000 and 2006.

faqLeft.q: Which Land Rover models use the M47D20?
Does the M47D20 differ between Land Rover models?
faqLeft.a: Yes. While the base engine is shared, the specific ancillaries and mounting differ by application. We always match by registration/VIN before confirming any rebuild or replacement.

faqLeft.q: Is a M47D20 from a Defender compatible with a Freelander?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. Ancillaries, mounting, and specific installation details differ. We always confirm compatibility by registration/VIN.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover M47D20 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £1,900. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on M47D20 rebuilds across both Land Rover applications it's fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqRight.q: What are the common issues with the M47D20?
faqRight.a: Cam chain rattle, thermostat housing failure (stuck open or stuck closed), boost hose failure, injector seal leaks, and EGR valve clogging.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Land Rover M47D20 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Land Rover if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a M47D20 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most M47D20 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
